machineScope.reason: Single-machine supported installation (P-08): with one machine and no enrolled peer no replica exists. When a second machine is enrolled (the runner's multi-machine posture) this file stays the lease holder's working journal and its sealed bytes are replicated to the other machine and acknowledged before any send (tests/preview/journal-replication.ts). Compaction writes a verified replacement that retains every original record.

holds.portion: Rule 4's spend and recorded-state admissions are separately enumerated at capacityRefused: durable append refuses model-call reservations at the spend allowance, and intake or send intents at the recorded turn/reply and minimal-reserve bounds; launch binds both rungs
holds.remainder: the worker's earlier holds (a turn held as 'call cap' or 'reply cap' before it asks), the tool-turn and session-work reservation checks, and cap reporting (reachedJournalCap, reportJournalCap) are separate comparisons not funnelled through this predicate; each holds or refuses sooner, never later
